title.en: Which Original Festival Mask Would You Design?
title.zh: 虚构节庆之夜：你会设计哪张面具？

description.en: Design an original costume for one fictional evening through six choices about bells, windows and moving paper ribbons.
description.zh: 用铃声、窗口与活动纸带的六次选择，为虚构节庆一夜设计原创装扮。

introduction.en: This is about an optional fictional costume, not social masking, hidden identity, autism or a psychological assessment. All characters and motifs are original. You can enjoy the design without wearing anything.
introduction.zh: 这是自愿的虚构装扮，不谈社交伪装、隐藏身份、自闭症，也不作心理评估。角色与纹样均原创，不真戴也能玩设计。

focus.en: A costume that signals through a small sound, frames a changing view or leaves a visible moving trail.
focus.zh: 用小声音发信号、框出变化视野，或留下可见移动轨迹的装扮。

prompt.en: Your original mask has one special feature.

label.en: Tiny imaginary bells that answer one deliberate gesture.
label.zh: 想象小铃回应一个刻意手势。

label.en: A little frame that changes what the wearer points out.
label.zh: 小框改变佩戴者指出的景。

label.en: Paper ribbons that trace the character’s movement.

prompt.en: The festival begins quietly. Your character…
prompt.zh: 节庆安静开始，你的角色……

label.en: Frames a small overlooked decoration for others to notice.
label.zh: 框起易忽略小装饰让人看。

label.en: Makes one slow movement so the trail becomes visible.
Gives one brief sound with a clear beginning and end.
label.zh: 发一声短响，有明确始终。

prompt.en: Someone prefers to watch from a distance. You…

label.en: Let the movement remain visible without approaching them.
label.zh: 远远可看移动，不靠近对方。

label.en: Keep the imagined sound brief and easy to avoid.
label.zh: 让想象声音短，也容易避开。

label.en: Point out a decoration without requiring a response.

prompt.en: Your design must become simpler. You keep…

label.en: The one gesture that makes a recognizable little signal.
label.zh: 发出可认小信号的那一手势。

label.en: A single frame with an open view.
One ribbon whose path can be followed.
A character who notices the festival from unusual angles.
label.zh: 从特别角度看节庆的角色。

label.en: A character who gives each scene a small audible cue.
label.zh: 给每幕一处小声音提示的角色。

label.en: A character who draws passing routes in the air.
label.zh: 把经过之路画在空中的角色。

prompt.en: At the end of the evening, you preserve…

label.en: A drawing of one memorable path through the imagined air.
label.zh: 想象空中一条难忘路径的画。

label.en: The small view the frame helped me notice.
label.zh: 框帮我留意的一小幅景。

label.en: A written description of the character’s tiny signal.
label.zh: 角色小信号的一段文字描写。

summary.en: Your costume gives the fictional character a deliberate signal. A small chime marks a moment without requiring constant noise or turning every entrance into the center of the festival.
summary.zh: 你为虚构角色设计了一个有意发出的信号。一声短短的铃响，就能标记一个时刻，不必一直发声，也不用每次出场都成为全场焦点。

example.en: The character might raise one hand, make a brief imaginary bell sound and then leave the next scene to someone else.
example.zh: 角色可能举起一只手，发出一声想象中的短铃响，然后把接下来的场景留给别人。

strength.en: A bounded signal gives the design a recognizable action and makes it possible to describe the costume through something it does.
strength.zh: 一个简短的信号，能让装扮有一个容易记住的动作。描述角色时，也可以讲它会做什么，而不只讲外观。

tradeoff.en: Sound is not equally enjoyable for everyone. In the fictional festival, a silent gesture or written cue can carry the same role.
tradeoff.zh: 并不是每个人都喜欢声音。在这个虚构节庆里，一个安静手势或文字提示，也可以起到相同作用。

experiment.en: Invent a silent equivalent of your character’s one chime. Describe how a visitor could recognize it without hearing anything at all.
experiment.zh: 为角色的一声铃响，想出一个无声版本。描述一下：访客即使完全听不见，也能怎样认出这个信号。

summary.en: Your mask frames attention rather than concealing a secret identity. The fictional character helps one small piece of the festival become visible from an unexpected angle.
summary.zh: 你的面具像一个小框，把注意力引向一处景物，而不是用来隐藏秘密身份。这个虚构角色，会让节庆里的一个小角落从不同角度被看见。

example.en: A simple open frame might turn a hanging paper shape into a tiny landscape when the character holds it at just the right angle.
example.zh: 角色举起一个简单的空框，换一个角度看，悬着的纸片就可能变成一幅小小的风景。

strength.en: A frame gives the design an interactive invitation without requiring another visitor to perform, disclose anything or accept a character assigned to them.
strength.zh: 一个框，就能邀请别人换个角度看，不要求对方表演、透露私事，也不替别人分配角色。

tradeoff.en: Pointing out a view can become directing someone’s attention too firmly. Another visitor may prefer a different angle or no invitation at all.
tradeoff.zh: 指出一个视角，有时也可能让人觉得被要求照着看。别人可以选另一个角度，也可以不接受邀请。

experiment.en: Draw a plain festival scene and sketch two frames around different parts. Write a different original character line for each chosen view.
experiment.zh: 画一幅普通的节庆场景，框出两个不同的部分。针对每个画面，各写一句原创角色台词。

summary.en: Your costume makes a passing movement visible in imagination. The ribbon belongs to an original evening character whose story is expressed through a trail rather than a fixed emblem.
summary.zh: 你设计的装扮，让角色经过时的动作也能在想象里留下形状。这个原创夜间角色用纸带画出轨迹，靠移动来表达故事，而不是只靠一个固定徽号。

example.en: The character might move slowly past a drawn doorway, leaving a curved paper trail that suggests a greeting without needing words.
example.zh: 角色可能慢慢走过画中的门口，留下一条弯弯的纸带轨迹，像一个不用说话的招呼。

strength.en: A visible trail can make the costume’s motion part of its design and give even a simple character a distinct way to enter a scene.
strength.zh: 看得见的轨迹，能把动作变成装扮的一部分。即使角色很简单，也可以有自己独特的入场方式。

tradeoff.en: An elaborate moving design can crowd the imagined space. Keeping the trail small and optional helps the festival remain enjoyable for nearby characters.
tradeoff.zh: 过于复杂的活动装扮，也会挤占想象中的空间。让轨迹小一点，并允许选择是否展开，附近的角色才能自在参与。

experiment.en: Draw three still positions of one imaginary ribbon movement. Give the sequence a short title that describes its path rather than a hidden personality.
experiment.zh: 把一次想象中的纸带动作画成三帧静止画面。取一个描述移动路径的短标题，不必把它解释成隐藏人格。

topic.zh: 原创节庆面具设计测试

title.zh: 原创节庆面具设计测试

description.en: Design a fictional costume through a tiny signal, a changing frame or paper-ribbon movement. Six choices create three original festival characters, each with its own guide.
description.zh: 用小信号、变化视框或纸带移动，设计虚构装扮。六次选择，组成三种原创节庆角色，各有完整指南。

question.en: Is this mask quiz about hiding my true self?
question.zh: 这里的面具，是在测怎样隐藏真实自己吗？

answer.en: It concerns an optional costume for one invented evening. Bells give a bounded signal, a window frames a view, and ribbons trace movement. Social masking and hidden identity are not what these choices assess.
answer.zh: 这里谈一个虚构夜晚的自愿装扮。铃声给有限信号，小窗框出视角，纸带描移动轨迹；选择不评社交伪装或隐藏身份。
